如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    “老头子，你再给我检查一下吧。我觉得自己得了不治之症。”
“不用检查了，臭小子，你根本没病。放心吧。你只是被玻璃割破了脚，没什么大碍。”
“是吗？可是，我还是觉得头晕眼花，而且脑袋嗡嗡的。总有个人在我耳朵旁边说一些奇怪的话。”
最近杨云帆真是郁闷透顶。
自从他在山上的破旧药王庙旁边踩到了一颗碎玻璃珠子之后，他就开始倒霉了。一到了晚上，他总能听到一个老头说些奇怪的话。这种情况持续了一个礼拜，他感觉自己快疯了。只能求救自己这个神通广大的师傅。
“没什么可是的！我确定，你没事了！臭小子，你是不是故意找借口不想回湘潭市？我可跟你说啊，你爹当初把你托付给我，让我教你武功，又教你医术，我可都做到了。至于你……赶紧给我滚回你们杨家去，你家里还有一个美貌未婚妻等着你呢。”
什么美貌未婚妻？你不就是想等我离开之后，一个人可以不受打扰的看毛片了而已。
杨云帆忍不住心中吐槽。
不过这话，杨云帆是绝对不会说出口的。
眼前这个老头子，别人不知道，杨云帆可清楚的很。也不知道这老头什么来头，功夫高的离谱，还有一手神奇的医术。要不是他说自己那死去的老爹跟他儿子是结拜兄弟，他才不管自己的死活，就让自己在杨家家族里面内斗被人整死得了。
此时，这个老头一只手吃着杨云帆刚刚买回来的烧鸡，另外一只手则是在杨云帆的脉搏上有一搭没一搭的探着。没过多久，就宣布杨云帆没病。还让他没事赶紧就滚回他的中海市老家去。
“老头子，不管怎么说，我都要谢谢你，教会了我那么多东西。对了，你觉得这只烧鸡的味道怎么样？”杨云帆忽然语气一改，有些讨好起来。
“烧鸡的味道嘛，马马虎虎，还可以……”
说到这里，忽然间，老头子感觉到了什么不对劲。
“哎呦，你这个臭小子，竟然给老子下毒！”说完，老头子提起裤子，扭动着屁股，快速往厕所狂奔而去。
看着老头子夺门而出，杨云帆忍不住哈哈大笑：“苍天啊，总算成功了一次……”
算上这次，杨云帆一共在老头子的食物里面，下了八十多次毒。每一次都让老头子识破，然后把自己暴揍一顿。没想到，今天终于成功了。
老头子一边捂着肚子在厕所里劈哩啪啦，一边大声嘶吼道：“杨云帆，你这个臭小子，给老子等着……”
“我等着？我又不傻！”
杨云帆一听这话，哪里还敢等着，忙收拾了自己的衣服，一边跑下山，一边道：“师傅，我们师徒缘分已尽。徒弟发现自己尘缘未了，先下山去了……”

等杨云帆走后，老头子一点不见有事的样子从厕所出来，嘿嘿一笑。
“要不是我故意上当，你这臭小子，能这么痛快的下山？”
一列银白色动车快速行驶在铁轨上，穿过一片绿意盎然的平野，如同一条游弋在静海中的银色鳗鱼。
“火车票也涨价了。一张二等座硬座，竟然也要300块钱！”虽然车票很贵，但是杨云帆却不怎么抱怨。因为，这一次他的运气竟然不错。他的旁边，竟然坐了一个个美女。
没办法，男人都是视觉系动物，杨云帆也不例外。
杨云帆趁着喝水的时候，偷偷看了一眼右边的美女。谁让这美女身上时不时的飘来一丝香味，让杨云帆心里有点痒痒的。
那个美女看起来二十来岁，跟杨云帆年纪差不多，估计是个女大学生。
只见她长发微卷，脸蛋精致，跟电视上的明星，高圆圆有点像。她身上一套浅蓝色的丝质长裙，露出的手臂皮肤透着陶瓷般的光泽，好似凝脂雪膏一般柔滑。一低头，长发便如丝绸般跳动了一下，将江南女子娉娉婷婷、水灵清秀的特质表露无遗。
这样精致的女生，别说是在杨家村那种山沟沟里面，就算是放到东南沿海大城市，那也是百里挑一的女神。
最让杨云帆印象最深刻的是这个美女的眼睛，朦朦胧胧，好似蒙了一层水雾、烟雨一般，极有灵气。顾盼流转，宛如梨花带露，清新秀丽，又有几分娇弱。
“呀。”
然而这时，那美女忽然微微蹙了一下眉，将眉头拧成了一个川字。
这一下，杨云帆却是忽然大惊。因为这美女原先的相貌十分好，可谓是大富大贵之相。然而这眉头一凝，竟然让杨云帆看出了，她的面相竟然有白虎出牢笼的趋势。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. "Old man, please check me again. I think I have an incurable disease."
"No need to check, brat, you're not sick at all. Don't worry. You just cut your foot on the glass, it's nothing serious."
"Really? However, I still feel dizzy and my head is buzzing. There is always someone saying something strange next to my ear."
Yang Yunfan has been really depressed recently.
His bad luck began after he stepped on a broken glass bead next to the dilapidated Yaowang Temple on the mountain. At night, he could always hear an old man saying something strange. This went on for a week and he felt like he was going crazy. I can only ask for help from my master, who is so powerful.
"It's nothing! I'm sure you're fine! Brat, are you deliberately making excuses not to go back to Xiangtan City? Let me tell you, your father entrusted you to me when he asked me to teach you martial arts and medical skills, and I did it all. As for you... hurry back to your Yang family. You have a beautiful fiancée waiting for you at home."
What kind of beautiful fiancée? Don’t you just want to wait until I leave so you can watch porn alone without being disturbed?
Yang Yunfan couldn't help but complain in his heart.
But Yang Yunfan would never say these words.
Although others don't know about the old man in front of him, Yang Yunfan knows it very well. I don’t know where this old man comes from. He has ridiculously high kung fu and miraculous medical skills. If he hadn't said that his dead father and his son were sworn brothers, he wouldn't have cared about his life or death, and would have allowed himself to be tortured to death due to infighting within the Yang family.
At this time, the old man was eating the roast chicken that Yang Yunfan had just bought with one hand, while the other hand was constantly feeling for Yang Yunfan's pulse. Not long after, it was announced that Yang Yunfan was not sick. He also told him to go back to his hometown in Zhonghai City as soon as possible.
"Old man, no matter what, I have to thank you for teaching me so many things. By the way, what do you think of the taste of this roast chicken?" Yang Yunfan suddenly changed his tone and became a little flattering.
"The roast chicken tastes so-so, but it's okay..."
Having said this, the old man suddenly felt something was wrong.
"Oh, you brat, you actually poisoned me!" After saying that, the old man lifted up his pants, swung his butt, and ran to the toilet quickly.
Seeing the old man rushing out of the door, Yang Yunfan couldn't help laughing: "Oh my god, I finally succeeded..."
Counting this time, Yang Yunfan poisoned the old man's food more than 80 times in total. Every time, the old man found out and beat him up. Unexpectedly, it finally succeeded today.
The old man was holding his stomach and banging in the toilet, while shouting loudly: "Yang Yunfan, you stinky boy, wait for me..."
"I'm waiting? I'm not stupid!"
When Yang Yunfan heard this, he didn't dare to wait. He quickly packed his clothes and ran down the mountain, saying: "Master, our fate as master and apprentice has ended. The apprentice found that his fate was not over, so he went down the mountain first..."
After Yang Yunfan left, the old man came out of the toilet as if nothing happened and smiled.
"If I hadn't been deceived on purpose, how could you, such a brat, have gone down the mountain so happily?"
A silver-white high-speed train drove quickly on the railway track, passing through a green plain, like a silver eel swimming in a quiet sea.
"The price of train tickets has also increased. A second-class hard seat costs 300 yuan!" Although the tickets are expensive, Yang Yunfan doesn't complain much. Because this time, his luck turned out to be good. Next to him, there were beautiful women sitting.
There is no way, men are all visual animals, Yang YunSail is no exception.
While Yang Yunfan was drinking water, he secretly glanced at the beauty on the right. Who makes Yang Yunfan feel a little itchy from time to time with a hint of fragrance coming from this beautiful woman.
The beauty looked to be in her twenties, about the same age as Yang Yunfan, and she was probably a female college student.
I saw that her long hair was slightly curly and her face was delicate. She looked a bit like the TV star Gao Yuanyuan. She was wearing a light blue silk dress, and the skin of her exposed arms had a porcelain sheen, as smooth as gelatin. As soon as she lowered her head, her long hair bounced like silk, fully revealing the graceful, graceful and delicate characteristics of Jiangnan women.
Such an exquisite girl, let alone in a ravine like Yangjia Village, even in a big city on the southeast coast, she would be one of the best in a hundred.
What impressed Yang Yunfan the most was the beauty's eyes, which were hazy, as if covered with a layer of mist or mist, and were extremely spiritual. The flow of glances is like a pear blossom with dew, fresh and beautiful, but also a bit delicate.
"Yeah."
However, at this moment, the beautiful woman suddenly frowned slightly and twisted her brows into the character "Chuan".
This time, Yang Yunfan was suddenly shocked. Because this beauty originally had a very good appearance and could be said to be rich and powerful. However, this frown made Yang Yunfan see that her face had the tendency of a white tiger coming out of its cage.
